original_target.title: Sharp few-distance bound for arbitrary normed spaces

scope_comparison: The full target requires both the all-norm (k+1)^d cardinality bound and equality rigidity. The original Conjecture1 and survey Conjecture15 retain both. Planar, parallelotope, k=1 and lp/product-norm results and weaker general2^(kd) bounds do not cover every norm. A variable-dimension isosceles-free construction has a different conclusion.
